_note: Title screen layout, in 1920x1080 pixels. Colours are [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a] from 0 to 255; opacities, shades and scales 0 to 1.

background._note: BgTile.png repeats over the screen every tile_width x tile_height, at tile_opacity; behind a popup (online notice, save choice, custom stages) at overlay_dim_opacity.

menu._note: The boxes of the menu, the chosen one centred on (center_x, center_y), box_gap between two. A box further than cull_margin off screen is not drawn. title_top / desc_top place the texts' tops from the box's top. The texts are outlined in the entry's colour times outline_darken.

version._note: The version watermark, its top left at (x, y).

notice._note: The online-play-is-off popup, centred on the screen: width wide, base_height + one line_height per line of text high. The text wraps at width - text_inset; its first line is text_top under the panel's content top, the OK button top under the last line.

player_select._note: The player-count selector. Ribbon bands: tops at band_top_y / band_bottom_y, tile_count tiles of tile_width, ribbon tips tip_width wide; the lower band is the upper art turned by lower_rotation_deg. The prompt is centred on (prompt_x, prompt_cy + text_nudge). Boxes (box_w x box_h) centre on (box_cx, box_cy); step_1 is the centre distance to the first neighbour, step_2 to each further one; side_shrink and side_darken are the scale and grey lost one step away from the centre. label_top: the label's top in box pixels, as the title menu draws its titles; label_dx, art_dx, art_dy: the label's and the art section's centre from the box centre. The label's outline is the box colour (0 to 1) times label_outline_scale (0 to 255; 89 is about 0.35 x 255). dim_opacity: the dim behind the selector once open (the menu fades by 1 - dim / dim_opacity). box_colors: back, then 1 to 5 players.
